desc: Exhaustively validate the bulk-transfer normal-form algorithm against BFS reachability on small instances and fix any counterexample.
Prove necessity and sufficiency of oriented-rewrite normal forms via termination and confluence.
Establish the bulk-transfer/data-structure amortization bound and ensure no superlinear requeue behavior.
Validate edge cases: N<X+Y, X=Y, X=1, Y=1, alternating, and uniform strings.
